hypothesis: The causal near-ATM put-call implied-vol skew has a positive monotone relationship with subsequent forward realized return variance of the same underlying's signed return.
extends: EVAL-71 (skew surface signal and floor verbatim) + EVAL-111 (single-asset skew path) + EVAL-172 (forward realized return variance target and inference verbatim)

data_availability.note: uses the already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures; no acquisition and no network

protocol.title: Single-asset options implied-vol surface SKEW -> forward realized return variance of the signed return predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-71 (skew surface signal and floor verbatim) + EVAL-111 (single-asset skew path) + EVAL-172 (forward realized return variance target and inference verbatim)
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-111 (skew -> forward return skewness), EVAL-121 (skew -> kurtosis), EVAL-164 (skew -> CVaR), and EVAL-172 (atm_iv -> variance); no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM put-call implied-vol skew from the real option trade tape, forward-filled and expanding-z-scored at end-of-bar k
protocol.target_detail: forward realized return variance = mean((r - mean(r))**2) over the next H perpetual log returns, strictly after the decision at bar k
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank IC = rho(skew_z_k, forward_variance_k); directional permutation H1: IC > 0
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses the already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures; no acquisition and no network

floor.note: Reuses the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor verbatim, applied to BOTH BTC and ETH. Below the floor the campaign seals BLOCKED, never NO-GO. This is NOT the EVAL-64 ladder floor.
